# @welingtonms/xb

> Lit custom elements (`xb-*` tags) for framework-agnostic UIs.

## Docs for AI agents

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): rules, tag catalog, registration, Vite setup
- [README.md](./README.md): install and quick start
- [CONTEXT.md](./CONTEXT.md): domain vocabulary
- [docs/adr/](./docs/adr/): architecture decisions
- [Storybook](https://welingtonms.github.io/xb/): component examples

## Install

```bash
npm install @welingtonms/xb
```

Import `@welingtonms/xb/tokens/css`, register families via `/register` paths, use `xb-*` tags in HTML.
